changes.behavior: Default Review decision authorization derives a private case scope for each persisted Portfolio resultRef. It reopens C08 under the current authenticated principal, verifies exact result/schema/request digest, same case incarnation and current membership, then pins and rechecks the full result/case digest before egress. Each result has its own closure; no business.withCase/ambient request binding is required or created. Published Portfolio history/provenance readers and current C09 guards remain intact.

protectSfReviewReads decorates the shared composed Review port before consumers run. HTTP read, rendered page, report, download, comparison and closure keep the published producer ACL checks and additionally verify the exact body against its own original C08 receipt twice around a second source authorization pass. A separate valid review of identical sources cannot authorize a tampered body/receipt. Legacy full-body receipts remain supported; the original writer may differ from the current authorized reader.

Source version advance preserves exact authorized history; host revocation suppresses read/download
